BooStreamTiles.name: Minor extended sprite 0A: Boo stream
summary: Tile table (12 slots) followed by the main routine of minor extended sprite 0A, the Boo stream trail (probably from the Boo ring/stream effect).
Hurts Mario on contact (8x8 hitbox offset +4,+4), counts down the timer in [$1850,X] and draws one 16x16 tile (BooStreamTiles[slot]).
Parameters: X = minor extended sprite slot (0-11), also in [$1698].

WaterSplashTiles.name: Minor extended sprite 07: water splash
summary: Tile table and routine for type 07. Timer [$1850,X] counts up from 0 to $20: it sinks and wobbles horizontally after $10, using tiles from the table.
Deletes itself (clears [$17F0,X]) off-screen or when the timer reaches $20.

RipVanFishZsTiles.name: Minor extended sprite 06/08/09: floating Z
summary: Tile table and routine shared by types 06, 08 and 09 (06 = Rip Van Fish Z; 08/09 draw fixed tile $7F; type 09 moves the opposite way).
X speed wobbles by 1 every 16 frames, rises 1 pixel every 4th timer step and is deleted when the timer hits $14.
The AND #$00 at $028DEA makes a test always fall through (leftover from an earlier design).

s028E7E.name: Minor extended sprite 03: spinning falling tile
summary: Moves by its X/Y speed with gravity (Y speed += 2 per frame), draws tile $6F with flips taken from timer bits 6-7. Deleted when ([$1850] & $3F) = 0 or off-screen.

StarSparkleTiles.name: Minor extended sprite 02/05: star sparkle
summary: Tile table and routine for types 02 and 05. Timer in [$1850,X] counts down to 0, picking the tile from timer / 8; type 05 uses the last three tiles.
Deleted when the timer reaches 0 or off-screen.

LavaSplashTiles.name: Minor extended sprite 04, 01 and bounce sprite loop
summary: Contains: lava splash tiles and type 04 routine ($028F2F); the common delete stub ($028F87); type 01 brick piece routine ($028F8B);
the bounce sprite loop ($02902D) and per-slot dispatcher ($02904D).
Type 04: falls with gravity, tile from timer / 8. Type 01: brick piece falling with X and Y speed, spinning tiles $3C/$3D, optional palette cycling.
$02902D: counts down the multiple coin block timer [$186B], then for slots 3..0 runs the bounce sprite code, interaction ($029398) and extended sprite code ($0296C0).

BounceSpritePtrs.name: Pointer table: bounce sprite routines
summary: Indexed by bounce sprite type [$1699,X] (via ExecutePtr). Types 01-06 share BounceBlockSpr; type 07 is TurnBlockSpr.
Also holds DATA_029072 at $029072 (4 bytes, Y acceleration for the turn block).

TurnBlockSpr.name: Bounce sprite 07: turn block routine
summary: Handles the spinning turn block: first frame creates an invisible solid block, applies Y gravity while bouncing and on the last frame snaps to the 16-pixel grid and generates the final block.
Parameters: X = bounce sprite slot.

s0290CE.name: Data: bounce block acceleration and Mario speed tables
summary: Four 4-byte tables indexed by direction ([$16C9,X] & 3): Y acceleration, X acceleration, Mario Y speed, Mario X speed ($80 = leave alone).

BounceBlockSpr.name: Bounce sprite 01-06: bounce block routine
summary: Shared routine for bounce blocks (turn without spin, music, question, sideways, translucent, on/off). Draws itself, sets up an invisible solid block once, moves by its speeds
and accelerates it back. Direction 3 carries Mario on top, then launches him ($A0) when the timer ends. At the end it turns into the final block (TileFromBounceSpr0).
Type 6 (on/off block) also toggles [RAM_OnOffStatus] and plays sound $0B.
Parameters: X = bounce sprite slot.

TileFromBounceSpr0.name: Turn bounce sprite into its block
summary: Chooses the block to generate from [RAM_BounceSprBlock,X]. Multiple coin blocks ($0A/$0B) become a used block ($0D) on their last hit ([$186B] = 1). Falls to TileFromBounceSpr1.
Parameters: X = bounce sprite slot.

InvisSldFromBncSpr.name: Generate invisible solid block
summary: Sets the block to generate to $09 (invisible solid) and falls into TileFromBounceSpr1.

TileFromBounceSpr1.name: Generate block at bounce sprite position
summary: Sets [RAM_BlockBlock] = A, block position = bounce sprite position + 8 rounded down to a 16-pixel grid, [$1933] = layer flag, then JSL GenerateTile.
Parameters: A = block number; X = bounce sprite slot.

s0291ED.name: Data: bounce sprite OAM indexes
summary: OAM offsets for bounce sprite slots 0-2 ($10,$14,$18); slot 3 reads the first byte of BounceSpriteTiles.

BounceSpriteTiles.name: Table: bounce sprite tile numbers
summary: Tile numbers indexed by bounce sprite type (0-7), used by BounceSprGfx.
